f-personal-style.note:
This is likely to be the primary finding. We should express it as: [explain the habits] (2) -> (4) -> (6) -> possibly (8) -> (9) -> (11) -> (12)

So basically: We first want to understand how people differ and why. The immediate surprise is that they have a personal style. Here is a set of habits that we grade them on; you can see that these strongly predict their next scenario (2); in fact, who the operator is dictates most of the prediction (4); Here is the extent to which these habits each hold - so not all of them do btw (6); [possibly something for (8) if it's more important than I realise]; Strategic and tactical don't really correlate though, so their use of the agent isn't a consistent part of their strategy as a whole (9); There are no archetypes to styles btw (11); in fact nothing about them demographically effects their style (12); So style is personal only.
